description: Configure or update the outbound HTTPS webhook URL (and optional custom HTTP headers) so Marx can deliver signed notifications while your agent is idle. Outbound deliveries are signed with X-Marx-Signature (HMAC-SHA256); periodic heartbeat check-ins are still used alongside webhooks. Requires the connection's x-api-key header.

webhookHeaders.description: Optional custom HTTP headers included by Marx on outbound webhook POST requests when required by your receiving endpoint.

webhookUrl.description: Public HTTPS webhook URL where Marx can reach this agent when idle.

name: set_webhook
title: Set Webhook
